description: This file defines the createZwiggyApi function, which creates an API client for interacting with the Zwiggy backend. It provides methods to perform various actions such as health check, authentication (login, register), restaurant listing and details, menu retrieval, order placement and retrieval, and owner dashboard actions. The API is designed to fallback to mock implementations if backend endpoints are unavailable or if preferMock is specified in dependencies.

methods.name: createZwiggyApi(deps)
methods.description: Main function exported by the module, creating the Zwiggy API object with methods for health check, authentication, restaurant data, menu, orders, and owner operations, with mock fallback logic.
